note: Public qualification evidence. These official transcripts and source URLs are verifier-side calibration artifacts and are not copied into the agent image.

cards.semantic_card: There is a strain in demanding that a central authority override deliberately obstructive national rulebooks while insisting the same authority must never steer which technologies or products succeed.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: ein Produkt, eine Dienstleistung, ein Regelwerk
cards.audit_note: The source simultaneously demands action against national protectionism and rejects centrally directed technologies, supporting the stated tension.

cards.semantic_card: Where an identical product costs far more in a lower-income member country, public funds poured into buildings rather than into household buying power leave those consumers no better defended against rising prices.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: gradili privatni hoteli i privatne poliklinike, obnavljali bazeni
cards.audit_note: The source links higher prices in weaker-purchasing-power markets with recovery spending diverted away from purchasing power and anti-inflation measures.

cards.semantic_card: Treating regulatory certainty as a security asset implies predictability deserves the same urgency as defence or supply questions, because an economy unable to plan cannot absorb external shocks.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: sigurnost, predvidljivost i stabilan investicijski okvir
cards.audit_note: The source connects certainty, predictability and a stable investment framework directly to resilience, strategic autonomy and long-term prosperity.

cards.semantic_card: If reducing regulatory volume and instability does not improve investment and productivity relative to jurisdictions retaining heavier burdens, the speaker's causal diagnosis would lose support.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: solo cuatro de las cincuenta mayores empresas tecnológicas del mundo son europeas
cards.audit_note: Speech makes regulatory volume and legal uncertainty the stated cause of weak investment and productivity, and contrasts a lighter-legislating jurisdiction with a heavier one; the card turns exactly that causal claim into a disconfirming condition.

cards.semantic_card: Calling energy strategic is inconsistent with allowing project delivery to take a decade and prices to remain opaque, while regional firms also struggle to obtain finance.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: kasmet per 300 mlrd. eurų. Apie 2 proc. Europos Sąjungos BVP tiesiog yra nepasiimama
cards.audit_note: Speech itself poses the inconsistency between calling energy strategic and a ten-year path from design to delivery with unclear pricing and differing tariffs, and separately says borrowing is near-impossible for firms in the regions.

cards.semantic_card: An external auditor's verdict that existing rules go unenforced undermines any claim that fresh legislation is the remedy, since months spent preparing for compliance are months not spent creating value.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Dienstleistungen machen rund 70 % unserer europäischen Wirtschaftsleistung aus, aber nur 20 % werden grenzüberschreitend in anderen Mitgliedstaaten erbracht
cards.audit_note: An external audit finds weak enforcement, while the source explicitly says lengthy compliance preparation diverts resources from innovation and value creation.

cards.semantic_card: If unnecessary internal barriers were removed without weakening social protections, competitiveness could improve without sacrificing the quality of life the speaker treats as the continent's advantage.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Ihmisten hyvinvointi ja elämisen laatu, sen pitäisi olla meidän päätavoitteemme
cards.audit_note: Speech opens by conceding that unnecessary internal-market barriers should be removed, then argues that the deregulatory line destroys the wellbeing and quality of life that are the continent's only real attraction.

cards.semantic_card: Choosing to route around obstacles rather than remove them is an admission that direct dismantling has failed after decades, and it leaves the underlying barriers untouched for whoever cannot use the detour.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: podporuji 28. režim, protože si myslím, že projekt EU Inc. je v tuto chvíli to maximum možného
cards.audit_note: The speaker accepts a workaround because direct barrier removal has stalled for decades; a workaround necessarily leaves the original barriers in place.

cards.semantic_card: A flat public denial that a problem exists cannot be reconciled with the same figure's earlier pledge to act against it, so one statement must give way.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: In Deutschland verschwinden in der Industrie jeden Monat 10 000 Arbeitsplätze
cards.audit_note: The transcript explicitly juxtaposes a categorical denial with the same person's prior announcement of measures addressing the denied problem and presents that juxtaposition as untenable.

cards.semantic_card: A widening gap between what is bought abroad and what is sold there suggests openness is advancing faster than domestic capacity can adjust, so further liberalisation contradicts the stated aim of building a common market.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Daugiau kaip 100 mlrd. eurų yra prekybos deficitas vien tik su Kinija
cards.audit_note: The source presents a widening trade deficit and further liberalisation agreements as harming domestic producers and contradicting market protection.

cards.semantic_card: Insisting the project remains unfinished conveniently shields its architects from judgement, since freedoms of movement operate widely today and the affluence they were meant to deliver never arrived.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: um mês de renda liberalizada custa mais do que todo o salário
cards.audit_note: The source says market freedoms already operate while promised prosperity did not arrive, and argues incompleteness rhetoric avoids responsibility.

cards.semantic_card: A published roadmap reveals actual priorities far more reliably than a speech does, so the absence of decent employment from that document is evidence the spoken commitment was mainly rhetorical.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: I don't see quality jobs as a priority
cards.audit_note: The speaker contrasts spoken commitments with a roadmap that omits quality jobs as a priority, supporting the rhetoric-versus-document implication.

cards.semantic_card: Because an unregulated market rewards the strongest and weakens social cohesion, common rules are presented as necessary to keep economic integration compatible with democratic resilience.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Competitività non è corsa al ribasso su salari, formazione, diritti e standard sociali
cards.audit_note: Speech contrasts a rule-based single market with a 'wild' market where the strongest wins and Europe ends divided and weak, opens with 'no competitiveness without cohesion', and closes by tying urgency to the resurgence of forces hostile to democracy.

cards.semantic_card: Judging this term by whether obstacles are fewer at its close than at its start is meaningful only if national administrations act, since most of the remaining work lies beyond the executive's own reach.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: 70 % du travail se situe également au niveau national, au niveau des réglementations et des législations nationales
cards.audit_note: The source proposes ending the term with fewer barriers and states that most remaining work is national, making the stated outcome a valid shared-responsibility test.

cards.semantic_card: If prosperity historically depended on keeping political power and business ownership apart, then decades of favouritism toward rulers' associates would have damaged not only that country's firms but its trading partners too.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: wenn es nicht über Jahre und Jahrzehnte nennenswerte Verbindungen zwischen Viktor Orbáns besten Freunden und den Wirtschaftsbossen gegeben hätte
cards.audit_note: The source attributes past prosperity to separation of politics and business and asks whether long-running favoritism harmed both linked economies.

cards.semantic_card: Shielding tired incumbents from rivalry cannot produce world-class firms; the harder route is funding shared infrastructure and training while letting the least efficient middlemen be squeezed out.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Podpořme konkurenční prostředí na jednotném trhu, které donutí firmy inovovat, snižovat marže
cards.audit_note: The source rejects protection of inefficient incumbents and instead advocates shared infrastructure, training and competition that removes unproductive intermediaries.

cards.semantic_card: An agreement settled between institutions before this chamber was properly involved begins with a legitimacy deficit, and it will ultimately be judged not by its wording but by measurable outcomes.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: su capacidad de convertirse en resultados concretos, medibles y tangibles
cards.audit_note: The source says earlier chamber involvement would strengthen legitimacy and that the agreement must be judged by concrete, measurable results.

cards.semantic_card: Requiring a narrow technological transition while domestic producers alone bear carbon costs undermines the manufacturing base needed to supply that transition.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: tutti i wafer che servono per il fotovoltaico sono per il 95 % prodotti in Cina
cards.audit_note: Speech criticises the electric-only choice, states that carbon pricing is a cost borne only domestically, notes heavy job losses in the affected sector, and argues the equipment for the transition is overwhelmingly imported while the domestic supply chain needs protection.

cards.semantic_card: When heads of government endorse a goal that their own ministers then resist, the obstacle is not absent conviction but a breakdown of coordination inside each national administration.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: trade barriers corresponding to tariffs of around 45 % for manufacturing, 110 % for services
cards.audit_note: The source contrasts leaders endorsing integration with their ministers producing counterarguments, directly supporting an internal coordination failure.

cards.semantic_card: If common policies systematically disadvantage less wealthy regions and concentrate capital in larger economies, integration cannot deliver the equal conditions the speaker demands.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: tőke és az innováció nem koncentrálódhat a nagy nyugat-európai gazdaságokba
cards.audit_note: Speech states that recent single-market measures were distorted to the detriment of one part of the Union, demands that equal conditions always be guaranteed, and objects that capital and innovation must not concentrate in the largest economies.

cards.semantic_card: Neighbouring governments that block the missing connection year after year shift the burden onto households far down the line, who bear inflated bills for a failure not their own.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: refuză să facă un interconector care să permită acest transfer de energie. Dar de când? De 10 ani de zile
cards.audit_note: The source directly assigns prolonged interconnection failure to neighboring governments and says households elsewhere bear the resulting inflated bills.

cards.semantic_card: Standards that no authority has the capacity to verify function as no standards at all, which makes inspection capacity rather than stricter drafting the decisive variable for fair competition.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Sidste år kom der næsten fem milliarder små pakker ind i EU
cards.audit_note: The source says authorities cannot inspect the incoming volume, so nominal product standards fail without sufficient enforcement capacity.

cards.semantic_card: Adopting only the convenient half of an advisory report invites the suspicion that the exercise was never balanced, and workers who cannot cover living costs will not supply the effort competitiveness requires.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: an ambitious quality jobs act that delivers fair wages, safe workplaces and new, enforceable workers' rights
cards.audit_note: The source criticizes selective use of an advisory report and argues underpaid, unhealthy workers cannot provide the capability competitiveness requires.

cards.semantic_card: Buying military equipment separately on incompatible systems wastes the one advantage that size confers, so larger budgets without joint purchasing mostly inflate duplication instead of delivering usable capability.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: bet tikai 18 % no tā, kolēģi, mēs iepērkam kopīgi
cards.audit_note: The source explicitly links separate procurement, incompatible systems and duplicated expenditure to failure to realize scale benefits.

cards.semantic_card: Letting firms opt out of national company law into a lighter parallel code turns the stricter regime into a competitive handicap, pushing supervision, taxation and board-level worker voice steadily downward.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: ein Angriff auf Arbeitnehmerinnenrechte und vor allem auf die betriebliche Mitbestimmung
cards.audit_note: The source says optional parallel company law would trigger downward competition in supervision, taxation, worker rights and participation.

cards.semantic_card: Idle deposits at home coexisting with founders raising money abroad shows the shortage is of channels rather than capital, and faster external than internal service trade confirms the obstruction is homemade.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: while EUR 10 trillion sit idle in European bank accounts, our start-ups move to the US for funding
cards.audit_note: The source contrasts idle domestic capital with external fundraising and faster external service trade, identifying fragmented national channels as the cause.

cards.semantic_card: Past versions collapsed under complexity, so the real risk is that negotiation quietly restores the paperwork the scheme was meant to abolish, leaving founders exactly where they began.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: 48 hours to establish an EU company, with a maximum cost of only EUR 100
cards.audit_note: The source says earlier schemes failed by missing simplicity and warns legislation must not restore complexity that defeats the new framework.

cards.semantic_card: Cohesion is better understood as convergence in real economic conditions than as transfers, since a founder in a lagging region gains nothing from grants while the rulebook remains unusable.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Предприемачът в София трябва да има същия шанс да успее, както предприемачът в Берлин, Париж или Амстердам
cards.audit_note: The source defines cohesion as real regional convergence, says firms want usable rules rather than subsidies, and illustrates unequal founder opportunity.

cards.semantic_card: A market that looks whole in the abstract but vanishes whenever one sector is examined closely leaves no foreign rival to blame for costs the members impose on themselves.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: jaarlijks zo'n 1 700 miljard EUR kosten
cards.audit_note: The source says the market disappears sector by sector and that the resulting costs are self-imposed rather than attributable to foreign rivals.

cards.semantic_card: If startups could scale under a single bloc-wide legal form and one digital compliance interface, expanding companies would no longer have to work through accumulated layers of separate bureaucratic requirements.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: European Business Wallet auf dem Tisch, also dieses Interface, über das sich Unternehmen künftig europaweit rechtssicher im Wirtschaftsraum bewegen können
cards.audit_note: The transcript proposes a common legal form, a common business interface, and relief from having to navigate many separate bureaucratic requirements as one simplification agenda for growing firms.

cards.semantic_card: If ownership of the largest firms drifts steadily toward those close to public office, smaller competitors face a tilted field, so defending them while tolerating that drift is incoherent.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: people who are directly linked to government officials
cards.audit_note: The source asks whether government-linked concentration of large firms harms small firms, supporting the tilted-field tension.

cards.semantic_card: Universal access to essential services requires locally informed housing investment, while cross-border banking integration remains incomplete until deposits receive common protection.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Housing is a fundamental right and the foundation of family security. We need to preserve it to preserve our demography
cards.audit_note: Speech calls universal access to essential services non-negotiable, gives local and regional authorities the primary role in housing and in mobilising funding because 'they know the solutions', and says a stronger economy needs the banking union completed through a common deposit insurance pillar.

cards.semantic_card: Confidence is the missing ingredient here: if the same activity must satisfy overlapping national add-ons, simplification without firmer enforcement of existing commitments will not lower costs at all.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Det er ikke mangel på idéer eller investeringer, der holder Europa tilbage, det er vores egne regler og barrierer
cards.audit_note: The source connects overlapping national additions to cost and uncertainty, then prescribes simplification plus stronger enforcement.

cards.semantic_card: An institution that busies itself with difficulties which would not arise unaided invites the charge that it manufactures its own workload, with past command systems offered as the precedent.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Overtaxation, overregulation, bureaucracy
cards.audit_note: The card safely abstracts the source claim that the institution creates problems and then expends effort addressing them, using past command systems as analogy.

cards.semantic_card: Because the remedy requires no borrowing at all, its absence cannot be explained by fiscal constraint, leaving unwillingness among governments as the only remaining explanation for the delay.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: não exige 1 euro de dívida; exige coragem política para derrubar as fronteiras internas
cards.audit_note: The source explicitly says the reform requires no new debt but does require political courage, making fiscal constraint an unavailable explanation.

cards.semantic_card: Firms innovate where employees feel valued, so presenting decent conditions and competitiveness as rival options misreads which of the two actually produces the other.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: innovative Unternehmen entstehen dort, wo Beschäftigte gerne arbeiten, wo sie gute Bedingungen vorfinden, wo sie Wertschätzung erfahren
cards.audit_note: The source states that valued workers and good conditions enable creativity, innovation and competitiveness, rejecting a trade-off between them.

cards.semantic_card: If those who teach and nurse cannot pay for a home within reach of their posts, vacancies follow, making shelter costs an economic constraint rather than a separate welfare matter.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: destinar nada menos que el 185 % de sus salarios a la vivienda
cards.audit_note: The source directly links unaffordable housing for essential workers to talent flight, vacancies and weakening local economies.

cards.semantic_card: If one reporting portal and mutual recognition replaced separate national procedures, delivery would begin restoring the trust that repeated unfulfilled promises have depleted.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: En portal za poročanje in medsebojno priznavanje v vseh državah članicah
cards.audit_note: Speech attributes falling trust to unkept promises, describes firms facing separate national legislations, endless bureaucracy and delays, proposes one reporting portal with mutual recognition across member states, and says trust returns only through delivery.

cards.semantic_card: Member-state refusal even to simplify and digitise routine posting procedures indicates that political resistance, rather than lack of known solutions, is blocking progress.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: fler än 5000 skyddade yrkestitlar
cards.audit_note: Speech reports that several member states flatly refuse even the simplification and digitisation of posting procedures, calls it the most obvious low-hanging fruit, and attributes the blockage to prestige rather than difficulty.

cards.semantic_card: Since the shortfall lies in fragmentation rather than in productive capacity, the case for deeper integration is strongest exactly where cross-border supply chains already operate daily and would notice any friction immediately.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Gerade in unseren Grenzregionen erleben wir, wie wichtig ein funktionierender Binnenmarkt ist
cards.audit_note: The source locates the shortfall in fragmentation and uses tightly connected border-region supply chains to show where friction is immediately consequential.

cards.semantic_card: A chamber whose central economic debate cannot hold the attention of the executive's head has a procedural problem before an economic one, and ceremonial business crowding it out compounds that.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: wird doch den Mut haben, sich einer parlamentarischen Debattenkultur so zu stellen, dass sie zumindest zuhört
cards.audit_note: The source objects that the executive head would not remain for the central debate and contrasts that with time spent on ceremonial business.

cards.semantic_card: Because small firms devote productive time to paperwork while large corporations can hire specialist advisers, additional complexity gives larger competitors a structural advantage.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Малките предприятия прекарват повече време в попълване на документи, отколкото в производство и инвестиции
cards.audit_note: Speech states that the compliance burden is unequal, that small firms spend more time on paperwork than on production and investment, and that large corporations can afford armies of consultants.

cards.semantic_card: Demanding predictable rules while repeatedly changing energy policy is inconsistent, and sacrificing a reliable generating source weakens the competitiveness that regulatory stability was meant to support.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: En faisant l'erreur stratégique de sacrifier le nucléaire, l'UE a sapé toute chance de compétitivité
cards.audit_note: Speech grounds quality jobs in investment and predictability, demands constancy of rules, asks that energy choices be shielded from dogma and geopolitical impulse, and says sacrificing a reliable generating source undermined any chance of competitiveness.

cards.semantic_card: A continent-wide company form will only earn acceptance if it carries floors on pay and participation; otherwise people experience integration as something imposed on them and turn away.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Eine EU-GmbH darf nicht zu Sozialdumping, Steuervermeidung oder dem Abbau von Mitbestimmung führen
cards.audit_note: The source makes acceptance of a common company form conditional on pay, participation and other social floors, warning that people otherwise turn away.

cards.semantic_card: Progress would be demonstrated only if the known barriers were actually removed and the executive could credibly report completion, rather than repeating another diagnosis.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: We know what the obstacles are. We must tackle those obstacles and remove them
cards.audit_note: Speech says the obstacles are already known and identified, demands removal rather than further talk, and expresses the wish to hear the executive finally state that the work is complete.

cards.semantic_card: Existing talent and household savings mean fragmentation and political timidity, not shortages of people or money, are the obstacles to stronger firms and the benefits they support.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Problem je v razdrobljenosti in v pomanjkanju poguma
cards.audit_note: Speech states explicitly that the problem is neither in the people nor in the money, but in fragmentation and lack of courage, and that without strong firms there are no quality jobs and no social or sovereign outcome.

cards.semantic_card: If living standards improved materially after a government took office, that outcome would weaken claims that its economic record was a failure.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Die Leute leben besser und dem Land geht es besser als vor dem Amtsantritt Viktor Orbáns
cards.audit_note: Speech rebuts criticism of a former government by asserting that people live better and the country is better off than before that government took office.

cards.semantic_card: Language promising stability for investors translates on the shop floor into longer and more elastic hours, so one word cannot describe an improvement for both sides at once.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: πρέπει να παλέψουν για συλλογικές συμβάσεις εργασίας, ικανοποιητικές αυξήσεις μισθών, σύγχρονα μέτρα υγιεινής και ασφάλειας στην εργασία για πενθήμερο - 7ωρο - 35ωρο
cards.audit_note: The source explicitly interprets investor predictability as labor flexibility and longer hours, supporting the stated incompatibility between meanings.

cards.semantic_card: Endorsing at one level the labour reforms you deplore at another is untenable, and a called general strike is evidence that those affected do not accept the distinction between levels.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Há alterações das leis laborais que põem em causa os direitos dos trabalhadores
cards.audit_note: The source calls it hypocritical to endorse worker rights while giving supranational cover to national labor-law changes opposed by a general strike.

cards.semantic_card: Announcing ever more sectoral unions without finishing any of them dilutes credibility, so committing to one dated horizon for completing them all would test whether the intention is serious.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Can you promise that by 2035 we will complete those unions
cards.audit_note: The speaker explicitly requests a dated completion promise for the many announced unions, making the deadline a valid seriousness test.

cards.semantic_card: Simplification becomes deregulation only when protections are removed; if national authorities instead stop adding extra layers, paperwork can fall while common standards remain intact.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: nous avons besoin d'un 28ᵉ régime, un socle de règles européennes communes, identiques dans les 27 États membres
cards.audit_note: Speech insists that simplifying is not deregulating, that standards are a condition of competitiveness provided there is no national over-transposition, and that entrepreneurs lose large shares of their time to forms.

cards.semantic_card: Calling a defensive veto short-sighted implies the anticipated losses are smaller than what is forgone, which is precisely the calculation a national leader is least willing to hear stated aloud.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: dass es kurzsichtig und falsch ist, aufgrund möglicher eigener Verluste das Zusammenwachsen des Binnenmarktes zu blockieren
cards.audit_note: Calling the veto short-sighted directly implies anticipated local losses are smaller than the integration benefits being forgone.

cards.semantic_card: Productivity presupposes people who are healthy and trained, so relegating the social dimension to the final item of a list inverts the order in which competitiveness is actually built.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Fără oameni sănătoși și bine pregătiți profesional, nu putem să avem productivitate și competitivitate
cards.audit_note: The source says healthy, trained people are prerequisites for productivity and criticizes placing the social dimension last.

cards.semantic_card: A market that moves goods and money freely while a growing share of those in work remain poor has met only half its purpose, and the gap will widen without deliberate correction.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: apie 90 mln. Europos Sąjungos piliečių skursta ir iš jų net 16 mln. dirbančių žmonių
cards.audit_note: The source contrasts free movement of capital and goods with growing in-work poverty and demands deliberate social correction.

cards.semantic_card: Judged as an instrument rather than a destination, integration should be assessed by whether it narrows gaps in taxation, wages and the cost of heating a home for ordinary households.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: limitando ad esempio i subappalti per contrastare lo sfruttamento, vietando i tirocini non retribuiti
cards.audit_note: The source explicitly treats integration as a means to social justice through aligned rights, taxation, wages and affordable energy.

cards.semantic_card: Demanding standards of domestic producers that imported goods need not meet is a handicap rather than competition, and today's convenient supplier can become tomorrow's leverage against you.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: cerrar acuerdos comerciales solo donde tenemos ventajas reales
cards.audit_note: The source says unequal standards handicap domestic producers and warns current external partners can become future adversaries.

cards.semantic_card: When responsibility for one site is split among scores of contractors, nobody is accountable for safety, so awarding work at the lowest price predictably converts cost savings into deaths.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Offentlig upphandling som ska bygga på bra arbetsvillkor, inte lägsta pris
cards.audit_note: The source links long subcontracting chains and lowest-price procurement to predictable workplace deaths and absent accountability.

cards.semantic_card: If workers could use their qualifications anywhere and founders could raise capital from investors elsewhere within the bloc, leaving for opportunity would become less necessary.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: a German florist can work in Sweden as easily as in Germany
cards.audit_note: Speech pictures a worker practising a trade in another member state as easily as at home and a startup raising funding from an investor in another member state instead of leaving the continent.

cards.semantic_card: When many firms benefit from market access yet increasingly report bureaucracy as a barrier to growth, preserving openness requires reducing the administrative burden.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: 75% przedsiębiorców korzysta z wolnego rynku Unii Europejskiej
cards.audit_note: Speech states that a large majority of entrepreneurs benefit from the open market while complaints about stifling bureaucracy are rising, and calls for a return to free-market conditions and lighter regulation.

cards.semantic_card: Because assembly work and supplier networks straddle a border, energy costs decided elsewhere squeeze both partners at once, which makes any purely national defence of industry impossible.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: deutsche Investitionen nach Ungarn gekommen sind, Arbeitsplätze geschaffen haben und auch den mittelständischen Sektor einbezogen haben
cards.audit_note: The source describes cross-border investment and supplier participation, then says common energy costs and policy decisions harm both industrial partners.

cards.semantic_card: Because governments lose reform momentum after accession, completing integration requires member states to renew the willingness to surrender national protections that entry once demanded.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Only if the countries themselves take the responsibility for the difficult giving up of sovereignty
cards.audit_note: Speech argues that states surrender sovereignty to join, that once inside they behave like tenured academics who stop producing, and that a true single market requires countries themselves to resume the difficult surrender of national interest.

cards.semantic_card: Cutting paperwork for employers cannot mean cutting protection for staff, because new workplace technologies and layered subcontracting create fresh risks precisely where oversight is being thinned.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: pravo na isključenje, zaštitu od zlouporabe umjetne inteligencije na radnom mjestu i veću sigurnost radnika u lancima podugovaranja
cards.audit_note: The source explicitly permits administrative simplification only without weakening worker protection, citing new-technology and subcontracting risks.

cards.semantic_card: That the most common destination for departing graduates lies inside the bloc shows integration works, yet uneven development turns free movement into an obligation rather than a genuine choice.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: a mobilidade é uma possibilidade e não é uma obrigação
cards.audit_note: The source says internal migration demonstrates integration while unequal development turns mobility from choice into necessity.

cards.semantic_card: A trading bloc's openness ultimately rests on the people staffing its quays and checkpoints, because compliant producers lose whenever unchecked consignments reach buyers more cheaply than properly certified stock.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Den svenska tullen stoppade 700 000 varor som inte levde upp till Europas krav
cards.audit_note: The source treats port and customs workers as the market front line and says unchecked noncompliant goods displace responsible firms and workers.

cards.semantic_card: Uniform labour rules would, in the speaker's view, spread overregulation across every member state, while preserving national differences allows regulatory competition.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: differences are a start for competition and competition is good globally
cards.audit_note: Speech states that identical labour-market rules would mean overregulating across all member states just to harmonise, and that differences are the starting point for competition.

cards.semantic_card: That agreement comes quickly when an outside counterpart sits opposite yet stalls when the same parties face each other shows the capacity for compromise exists and is simply not applied internally.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: für das Wachstum, das im Draghi‑Bericht auf mehr als 4,4 % jährlich geschätzt wird, alle zusammenarbeiten müssen
cards.audit_note: The source contrasts quick agreement with an external counterpart against internal stalemate, showing unused capacity for compromise.

cards.semantic_card: If each remaining barrier were assigned publicly to the government responsible, representatives could apply targeted pressure at home instead of debating obstacles only in general terms.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: para cuándo ese listado de barreras al mercado único por Estado que debemos eliminar
cards.audit_note: Speech asks when a per-government list of single-market barriers will be published so that members can go home and press for removal, and says it is time to stop speaking in generic terms.

cards.semantic_card: Choosing directly applicable instruments over those needing national transposition removes the discretion that generates divergence, yet much of what still blocks firms can be repaired only by national administrations themselves.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: we need to attack three areas of the problem at the same time
cards.audit_note: The source favors directly applicable regulations to avoid national additions while assigning purely national barriers to domestic administrations.

cards.semantic_card: Preferring what is made at home across the whole union turns trade policy into a shield, and that holds only if the jobs preserved are decent enough to justify the project.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: protéger nos emplois, mais aussi en créer de nouveaux
cards.audit_note: The source ties union-wide preference to protecting and creating quality jobs and to the social justice needed to defend the project.

cards.semantic_card: A parallel rulebook that sits alongside national ones only helps if firms actually choose it, so its value depends less on drafting than on whether cross-border founders find it simpler.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: um quadro jurídico uniforme à escala europeia que coexiste com os sistemas nacionais
cards.audit_note: Because the optional framework coexists with national systems and targets cross-border firms, its usefulness necessarily depends on firms finding it simpler and choosing it.

cards.semantic_card: A group that respects sectoral bargaining in its home market while refusing it in a foreign subsidiary shows the difference lies in what local law permits, not in what the business needs.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: robia zo slovenských zamestnancov pracujúcich druhej kategórie
cards.audit_note: The source contrasts sectoral bargaining by parent groups at home with refusal by subsidiaries abroad, attributing the difference to permitted local practice.

cards.semantic_card: The lever for removing barriers already exists in enforcement powers, so declining to use them makes the shortage of risk capital a symptom rather than the primary cause of stalled growth.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Vous pouvez obliger les États membres à démanteler ces barrières. Utilisez les pouvoirs avec les procédures d'infraction
cards.audit_note: The source calls national barriers the root cause, urges existing enforcement powers first, and treats fragmented risk capital as a subsequent problem.

cards.semantic_card: If living standards have slipped behind places once considered poor, the argument concludes that judgement about enterprise belongs with those who run it rather than with appointed administrators.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Najveći talenti sele u Ameriku, a danas najsiromašnija savezna država Mississippi ima isti standard kao jedna Njemačka
cards.audit_note: The source couples declining comparative living standards with the claim that ordinary operators understand business better than appointed administrators.

cards.semantic_card: Freedom to ship products means little when the networks carrying power, data and finance stop at each frontier, and young firms therefore run out of money long before they run out of ideas.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Wir haben einen Binnenmarkt für Waren, aber 27 nationale Mauern, wenn es um Energie, Telekommunikation und Kapital geht
cards.audit_note: The source contrasts a goods market with national walls in energy, telecommunications and capital, then says young firms are financially starved.

cards.semantic_card: Adding a poorly understood and distrusted payment instrument compounds regulatory complexity, while allowing different speeds of integration risks further fragmentation.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: 27 de interpretări diferite, complicate de hiperreglementarea de aici, de la Uniunea Europeană
cards.audit_note: Speech offers a proposed payment instrument as its example of added regulatory layers, saying nobody understands it and nobody trusts it, and separately rejects a two-speed Europe in favour of less fragmentation.

cards.semantic_card: If registering once and notifying once were enough, the paperwork accompanying a posted crew would shrink to a formality, and every new law ought therefore to be costed first against a small firm.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: jednej rejestracji cyfrowej, ważnej od razu we wszystkich 27 krajach
cards.audit_note: The source proposes one registration, one posting form and ex ante small-firm costing, directly supporting the stated counterfactual consequences.

cards.semantic_card: Weakening the bodies that inspect workplaces while accident numbers climb reveals whose interests the arrangement actually budgets for, since supervision is the one cost only employers benefit from cutting.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: το νομοσχέδιο για τη δεκατριάωρη εργασία
cards.audit_note: The source connects weakened inspection structures with rising employer-caused accidents and says the arrangement budgets for large firms over workers.

cards.semantic_card: A project that asked to be judged by the prosperity it promised must accept that same test, and distant climate projections carry little authority from forecasters who miss the coming week.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: 13 millions de chômeurs, 64 millions d’immigrés et la mort de cinq millions de fermes agricoles
cards.audit_note: The card omits the source’s harmful identity claims and accurately preserves its own prosperity test and weather-versus-climate forecasting analogy.

cards.semantic_card: Economic size becomes leverage abroad only if qualifications and finance move freely at home, and scattering related files across separate committees risks producing rules that contradict one another.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: riconoscimento delle qualifiche professionali, perché attrarre competenze è decisivo
cards.audit_note: The source links external leverage to qualification and capital mobility and requests cross-file committee involvement to preserve legislative coherence.

cards.semantic_card: An economic space large enough to set terms becomes a liability when it declines to use that weight, so openness without a strategy hands the advantage to whoever does have one.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: assumer une véritable préférence européenne dans la commande publique, c'est investir massivement dans les secteurs stratégiques
cards.audit_note: The source says an open market without strategy or protection becomes prey to powers that do use political leverage.

cards.semantic_card: Since no external obstacle prevents a national treasury from moving first, continued inaction is a choice, and honesty would require admitting the objective is not genuinely shared.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: It's all national protectionism, and if we want this to change, we need to be honest with ourselves
cards.audit_note: The source says national actors face no external obstacle, so continued protectionism reflects a choice incompatible with professed support.

cards.semantic_card: Universal agreement in principle combined with persistent blockage in practice implies the obstruction is deliberate, protecting particular domestic sectors whose losses would be concentrated while the gains stay diffuse.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: If we protect national monopolies, we will lose out on the global and on the international stage
cards.audit_note: The source explains universal agreement plus practical blockage through concentrated sectoral losses and diffuse larger gains.

cards.semantic_card: Withdrawing obligations after some businesses have already invested in meeting them punishes preparation and rewards delay, teaching every board that waiting out a requirement is the cheaper strategy.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: Die bedrijven namen het geld aan en stopten het in de pocket van de CEO’s en aandeelhouders. Ze sloten fabrieken
cards.audit_note: The source says withdrawing rules after some firms prepared rewards noncompliance and penalizes those that invested early.

cards.semantic_card: Financing projects abroad without designing tenders so domestic suppliers can compete means public money generates growth elsewhere, a self-defeating outcome that no amount of internal deregulation would correct.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: at det er de europæiske virksomheder, der rent faktisk får de kontrakter
cards.audit_note: The source says externally financed projects fail to create internal growth when tender design does not let domestic suppliers win contracts.

cards.semantic_card: When talented founders seek financing abroad, incomplete capital-market integration rather than lack of ability is the constraint, and adding new internal obstacles would leave it untouched.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: uno sportello unico europeo efficace per le imprese
cards.audit_note: Speech says talent has to look outside the continent for financing and calls for accelerating capital-market integration, and states that competitiveness is not defended by new obstacles but by freeing those who create and invest.

cards.semantic_card: Strategy documents cannot lower the electricity bill that closes a factory, and an online space where buyers enjoy no effective redress shows the promised certainty exists mainly on paper.
cards.supporting_source_excerpt: A magas energiaárak nem egyszerűen nehézséget jelentenek, hanem vállalatokat fojtanak meg
cards.audit_note: The source contrasts strategy documents with energy-driven factory losses and an uncontrolled digital market lacking legal certainty and effective consumer protection.
